        result.append(s.charAt(0));

        while (position < s.length()) {

                }
            }
            if (!changed && s.charAt(position) == 'a' && position + 1 < s.length() && at_used_flag == 0) {
                if (s.charAt(position + 1) == 't') {
                    result.append('@');

                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            if (!changed) {
                result.append(s.charAt(position));
                position++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
